TAL_LIGHTNING_SKY_FIRE_NERVE_NET.why: Sky-Fire Nerve Net: "When a creature fails a saving throw against Meridian-Stopping Spark, you may choose one additional Charged creature within 20 feet of it. The additional creature makes a Constitution saving throw." The save and both branches run here rather than as a modifier on Meridian-Stopping Spark, because the printed rule saves a second, different creature the owner picks, not the creature that already failed (combat/ext/lightning_riders.py, the after_save_resolved hook).

effects.evidence: The additional creature makes a Constitution saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

on_fail.on: the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration
on_fail.evidence: has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the end of its next turn.

TAL_LIGHTNING_MERIDIAN_STOPPING_SPARK.why: Meridian-Stopping Spark: "When you hit a creature with Electric Fist Method, Charged Needle, or a melee Conductive Strike, you may spend 1 CP to intensify the meridian shock." Its typed modifier named those three abilities, but all three are plug-in driven (feature blocks and combat/ext hooks) rather than compiled actions, so the compiler's named-target matcher had nothing to attach to and the whole rider was dropped as 'no matching ability'. It is delivered here instead, on the hit that actually carried one of them (combat/ext/lightning_riders.py, the after_hit_choice hook).

effects.evidence: The target makes a Constitution saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot regain CP

on_fail.on: Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration
on_fail.evidence: has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration

on_success.evidence: Until the start of its next turn, the target cannot regain CP

on_success.on: the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration
on_success.evidence: and has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration
